zh: 在使本书得以问世的人士中，有一个名字高居其余所有人之上；如果不是那些从共产主义中走出来的异见者给了我最初的灵感，他本应成为题献的对象。此人是斯蒂芬·格劳巴德，我多年的朋友、美国艺术与科学学院院刊《代达罗斯》的主编。1989年，当对戈尔巴乔夫改革共产主义的认同在西方还是占统治地位的正统时，斯蒂芬·格劳巴德突出发表了我那篇《致斯大林陵墓》中表达的强烈异议观点；这些观点我此前无法在任何同等地位的刊物上以未经删改的形式发表。没有他，本书以及此前那段迟来的苏联学生涯，都将不可能存在。
en: Among the persons who have made this book possible, one name leads all the rest; he indeed would have been the subject of the dedication, if the dissidents from Communism had not furnished my first inspiration. This person is Stephen Graubard, long-time friend and editor of the journal of the American Academy of Arts and Sciences,

In 1989, at a time when commitment to Gorbachev’s Reform Communism was the regnant orthodoxy in the West, Stephen Graubard gave prominence to the vigorously dissenting views I expressed in my article “To the Stalin Mausoleum,” views which I had not been able to publish in unadulterated form in any journal of comparable stature. Without him this book, and the belated Sovietological career which preceded it, would have been impossible.

zh: 本书接近完成时，我得益于加州大学伯克利分校历史系尼古拉斯·里亚萨诺夫斯基教授和斯坦福大学历史系特伦斯·埃蒙斯教授对全稿的细心阅读。伯克利两位非俄国研究的历史学研究生沃伦·布雷克曼和已故的韦塞林·斯凯基奇对若干关键章节的批判性阅读，也使我得到类似的益处。我还要感谢伯克利俄国史研究生阿瑟·麦基和约翰·伦道夫，他们在研究上给予协助，并在写作过程中提供帮助。最后，在本项目的不同阶段，我还从其他学生那里得到了各种打字、编辑建议和参考文献核对方面的宝贵帮助：肯尼思·霍奇斯、泽维尔·托马斯、戴维·沙帕德、伊利亚·温科韦茨基和约翰·格兰迪。不用说，所有这些人士都不对本书所表达的观点承担任何责任，并因帮助本书完成而受到衷心感谢。
en: Once the book was near completion, I benefited from thoughtful readings of the entire manuscript by Professor Nicolas Riasanovsky of the History Department of the University of California at Berkeley and Professor Terence Emmons of the Stanford History Department. A similar benefit derived from critical readings of certain key chapters by two non-Russianist graduate students in history at Berkeley, Warren Breckman and the late Veselin Skekic. I wish also to thank Arthur McKee and John Randolph, graduate students of Russian history at Berkeley, for research assistance and help in composition. Finally, at various stages of this project I received valuable aid with assorted of typing, advice with editing, and the verification of references from still other students: Kenneth Hodges, Xavier Thomas, David Shapard, Ilya Vinkovetsky, and John Grandy. Needless to say, all of these persons are absolved of any responsibility for the views expressed in this study, and warmly thanked for having helped it to completion.
